flashcard_questions.q: Generous giving or spending; in the novella, Dickens associates it with the true spirit of Christmas.
Also called a horn of plenty; a symbol of abundance and nourishment, typically depicted as a horn overflowing with fruit and food.
The action of saving or being saved from sin, error, or evil; Scrooge’s journey from cold-hearted miser to generous man.

flashcard_questions.a: A literary technique where the writer hints at events or outcomes that will occur later in the narrative.
A dress that has been taken apart and reassembled inside-out twice to hide wear, indicating the family cannot afford new clothing.
